notes.title: Campaign Reborn
notes.content:
🚨 Major Update: Full Campaign, UI Overhaul & More! 🚨
This is it! After three months of development and three weeks of testing, Portable Ops now has a full single-player campaign! 🎉

🔥 What’s New? 🔥

Complete Campaign Mode – Experience a fully realized story with tactically placed cutscenes featuring voice acting and subtitles.
New UI Overhaul – Inspired by Metal Gear Solid and classic Rainbow Six, the updated UI makes navigating the game smoother than ever.
Visual & Performance Upgrades – Every single model has been optimized and refined to improve performance across more systems.
💥 Is this the final update? Nope. We’re just getting started. While this update is a huge step forward, we know there will be some issues to iron out. Plus, we have big plans for the future, including:
✅ Multiplayer Upgrades – Optimized maps & dedicated servers.
✅ Full Controller Support – Bringing better accessibility and input options.
✅ Improved Progression & Customization – More depth and refinements to the leveling system.

These updates will take several more months, but for now, we hope you enjoy the new Single Player experience!

💬 Join the Community!
Spotted a bug? Have a feature request? Join us on Discord for direct feedback and discussions.

🙏 Thank You!
Your support and feedback mean everything. If you enjoy the update, please consider leaving a review for Portable Ops—it helps a ton!

See you on the battlefield. 🔥
- Kevin

notes.title: Portable Ops Campaign Update – Coming this Weekend!
notes.content:
The recreated Portable Ops campaign, now featuring cutscenes and full voice acting, is nearly ready! Over the past couple of weeks, we’ve been squashing bugs and smoothing out any glitches to ensure a seamless experience. The final step is rebuilding all the maps and lighting, which is a time-consuming process. For the next three days, my computer will be fully occupied with generating the maps!

We’ve also made some major improvements across the board:
🔹 All maps have been reoptimized—now running without Nanite for better performance across more video cards.
🔹 AI enhancements—better behavior and improved collision detection.
🔹 Revamped HUD—clearer and more informative than ever.

This update marks nearly four months of daily work, and we can’t wait for you to experience the campaign like never before. Get ready to jump back in! 🚀

notes.title: Campaign Redone Beta
notes.content:
**Portable Ops Beta Update – A Massive Overhaul!**  

For the past three and a half months, I’ve been deep in the trenches, squashing bugs across all levels, revamping the UI as a tribute to *Metal Gear Solid*, and introducing new menus, story-driven comms, and cinematic cutscenes. In the process, I've also overhauled the UX to bring more of the game’s feature and depth to the forefront.  

This update turned out way bigger than my brother and I originally expected—but it’s been absolutely worth it. We hope you’ll agree!  

### What’s New?  
🔹 **Enemy AI & Response Tweaks** – Expect some subtle but meaningful changes in enemy behavior.  
🎨 **Visual Presentation** – A refined tone for a more immersive experience.  
⚡ **FPS Improvements** – Performance is now slightly to moderately better, depending on your setup.  

### Coming in the Full Release: DLSS Support!  
We’re bringing **DLSS** to *Portable Ops* for **NVIDIA RTX** users. NVIDIA claims a potential FPS boosts of **2-3x**! This cutting-edge tech, now better integrated with Unreal Engine, leverages AI to deliver sharper visuals and smoother performance. It’s coming soon—we can’t wait to see the results!  

As always, thanks for playing, and let us know what you think of the latest beta! 🎮🔥

[b]To ACTIVATE the Beta:[/b]
Open Steam Library.
Right-click on Portable Ops and select Properties.
Inside Properties, look for Betas tab on the left side and open the Beta tab.
Near Beta Participate, Click Open the drop-down menu.
Select "pops-rebeta"

Your Steam should start downloading and update. Once installed, you may launch Portable Ops in your regular fashion. You will notice the difference to the Main game screen's menus. If you have any trouble, let us know.

[b]DISCORD: https://discord.gg/vhwPwRxj[/b]

notes.title: Portable Ops is OFFICIALLY RELEASED TODAY!!!
notes.content:
Last summer my brother wanted to make his game. A first-person shooter with elements from [b]Delta Force[/b] (a classic for those that remember) and action like Rainbow Six Vegas. We sprinkled in some old-school Call of Duty for fun. [i]Maybe a hint of Battlefield[/i]. The goal was a couple of arenas and to finish by the end of 2022... but... the game got bigger and bigger. [u]Over a year later and much more...[/u]

[h2]READY TO ROCK[/h2]
[b]It's here. [/b]Finally "done". Portable Ops is more than we expected. A full Single Player campaign. Lots of multiplayer maps and modes. Dozens of guns and weapons. Customizations for players, weapons, and loads. Class bonus, squad tactics, and more yet to come. Yes, we want more and there shall be more. Everything is ready to enjoy, now! Yes, now.

[b]BIRTHDAY[/b]
This happens to be Sean Ryan (aka Akari Kitachi), my brother's birthday as well! So show your support and help me make his birthday wish/dream come true! Let's make Portable Ops popular on Steam! [b]Please share this game with your friends on Steam and your usual Social platforms.[/b]

[b]A LITTLE HISTORY[/b]
We switch from Unity to Unreal in December 2022 due to audio and visual limitations. We wanted this game to look better than good, we wanted beautiful. Unreal Engine 5 just came out that same year so it was the choice. Turns out we had to go uphill to develop as UE5 was still being developed too. My brother had to come up with a lot of new ways to do things since they weren't there or documented yet. But after many sleepless nights and giving precious days with loved ones the percerverance has paid off.

[h2]SUPPORT[/h2]
[b]Primary: https://discord.gg/djP6N5E5MM[/b]
Secondary: Steam community

If there are any issues, we will work through them with our community and make sure you get a really good military shooter. We deeply appreciate you all for joining us on the making of this game. It was only possible by the support/feedback from this community & our passion for fun games to play with each other. I hope this game opens up new friendships, late-night memories & everything else that makes gaming a truly wonderful experience.

notes.title: Portable Ops Unreal Engine Edition is here!
notes.content:
There it is... finally. Unreal Edition of Portable Ops is finally multiplayer online! It's great to see it in action after all the issues getting it together. After the days of tracking down errors that would cause the package for release process to come to halt. It's finally here!

Try it out. There are some issues though.
[list]
[*] It seems the bots really eat up the Frames. More bots, less frames per second.
[*] Conquest mode is a new map with lock picking and preview of the VIP scenario. The bots are lost campers here.
[*] The other modes are what they say they are. The bots mostly work on them all... well a couple maps the bots just stand there and don't know what to do.
[*] By default the graphics are set to Ultra and the sound set to Low - IDK - we will need to tweak the default settings clearly.
[*] 
[/list]
